exports.export_authority: The explicit House authority to export the content outside the institution; it is never inferred from internal read access.
exports.recipient_authority_status: The recipient's authority to receive the content is recorded and confirmed before disclosure.
exports.disclosure_basis_status: An explicit disclosure basis is recorded; an absent or unresolved basis is not authorized.
exports.delivery_evidence: Delivery produces evidence distinct from generation.
exports.receipt_evidence: Recipient receipt produces evidence distinct from delivery.
exports.recipient_processing_status: Recipient processing is tracked distinctly and is not presumed from receipt.
exports.reconciliation_dependency: The export is reconciled; an unknown delivery or processing outcome is held as unknown until reconciled.

exports.export_authority: The explicit House authority to disclose the requested content to the requesting stakeholder.
exports.recipient_authority_status: The requester's entitlement to the content is confirmed before disclosure.
exports.disclosure_basis_status: An explicit disclosure basis for the access request is recorded.
exports.delivery_evidence: Delivery to the requester produces evidence distinct from generation.
exports.recipient_processing_status: Recipient acknowledgement is tracked distinctly from delivery.
exports.reconciliation_dependency: The fulfillment is reconciled to confirm the request was satisfied.
